title: TutorialCore: Core Loop
summary: Read the hint, try the action, claim the card, and move to the next lesson.

blocks.title: Repeatable Loop
blocks.body: Perform actions, earn progress marks, unlock cards, follow hints, and use recommendations to pick the next useful objective when the route feels unclear.

blocks.title: Pressure Check
blocks.body: After each card, check whether it taught a command, route, crafting step, or system warning. Use that lesson immediately so it sticks.

blocks.title: Stop Point
blocks.body: Stop following hints when they point beyond your current supplies. Tutorial guidance should pace the route, not drag you past readiness.

blocks.title: Loop Check
blocks.body: Run the loop once more only if the return path, inventory space, and next upgrade are clear.
